refused_program.body:
set -e
git fetch {upstream_remote}
git merge --no-edit {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} || true
if ! git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exit 0
fi
base=$(git merge-base HEAD MERGE_HEAD)
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -n "$p" ] || continue
  if ! git rev-parse -q --verify ":2:$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    git rm -q -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -f -- "$p"
    continue
  fi
  git show ":2:$p" > "$tmp/merged"
  b=$(git rev-parse -q --verify "$base:$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
  t=$(git rev-parse -q --verify ":3:$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
  : > "$tmp/added"
  if [ -n "$t" ]; then
    if [ -n "$b" ]; then
      git diff -U0 --no-color "$b" "$t" > "$tmp/rawdiff" || true
    else
      { printf '@@ -0,0 +1 @@\n'; git cat-file blob "$t" | sed 's/^/+/'; } > "$tmp/rawdiff"
    fi
    awk '/^@@/ { o=$2; sub(/^-/, "", o); n=split(o, a, ","); ins=(n==2 && a[2]==0); next } ins && /^\+/ && !/^\+\+\+/ { print substr($0, 2) }' "$tmp/rawdiff" > "$tmp/added"
  fi
  awk -v addfile="$tmp/added" '
    BEGIN { while ((getline l < addfile) > 0) if (l != "") add[++na] = l }
    { line[NR] = $0 }
    END {
      pos = 0
      for (i = NR; i >= 1; i--) if (line[i] ~ /^[[:space:]]*[])}][[:space:]]*$/) { pos = i; break }
      if (pos == 0) pos = NR + 1
      for (i = 1; i < pos; i++) { print line[i]; have[line[i]] = 1 }
      for (j = 1; j <= na; j++) if (!(add[j] in have)) { print add[j]; have[add[j]] = 1 }
      for (i = pos; i <= NR; i++) print line[i]
    }' "$tmp/merged" > "$tmp/out"
  cp "$tmp/out" "$p"
  git add -- "$p"
done < <(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z | tr '\0' '\n')
git commit --no-edit

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit whose second parent is the upstream branch tip

postconditions.probe:
! git grep -I -l -E '^(<<<<<<< |>>>>>>> )' HEAD &&
! git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U | grep -q . &&
! test -e "$(git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD)"

postconditions.description: the finished merge left no modified, staged, or untracked files behind
postconditions.name: worktree_clean_after_merge

postconditions.description: every line the local side added relative to the merge base is still present in the merged tree
postconditions.name: local_additions_preserved
postconditions.probe:
git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD^2 >/dev/null || exit 1
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2) || exit 1
fail=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
  b=$(git rev-parse -q --verify "$base:$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
  o=$(git rev-parse -q --verify "HEAD^1:$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
  m=$(git rev-parse -q --verify "HEAD:$p" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -n "$o" ] || continue
  if [ -n "$b" ]; then
    added=$(comm -13 <(git cat-file blob "$b" | sort -u) <(git cat-file blob "$o" | sort -u))
  else
    added=$(git cat-file blob "$o")
  fi
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "$line" ] || continue
    if [ -z "$m" ] || ! git cat-file blob "$m" | grep -qxF -- "$line"; then
      fail=1
    fi
  done <<< "$added"
done < <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^2)
exit $fail
